title: Article bookmarking handoff plan
purpose: Proposed handoff assembled from source-linked outcomes; human source review and approval required.

scope.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

requirements.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

stories.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.
acceptance_criteria: A reader can mark an article as bookmarked.
A reader who has bookmarked an article can remove that bookmark from the article.
After a reader bookmarks an article, signs out, and signs back in, the article remains bookmarked for that reader.

open_questions: Must a reader be signed in to bookmark or remove a bookmark, or can a signed-out user perform those actions?
Does removing a bookmark also persist across sign-in sessions, such that a removed bookmark stays removed after sign-out and sign-in?
How is the reader's bookmark or unbookmark action supplied to the system for an article?
What reader-visible response, if any, must follow a successful or failed bookmark or unbookmark action?
Which reader UI behaviors for bookmark, remove, and cross-session persistence apply under each possible request and response contract?
Who is the delivery owner for the bookmark feature?
What is the delivery date for the bookmark feature?
